features.text: ENHANCED FOOT POSITIONING: Maintains optimal alignment inside Ottobock AFOs for improved gait and comfort.
ADJUSTABLE STRAP SYSTEM: Hook-and-loop closures allow secure, personalized fit around calf and foot.
WASHABLE PADDED LINER: Machine washable for daily hygiene and long-term durability.
COMPATIBLE WITH MOST AFO MODELS: Designed to integrate with Ottobock WalkOn and similar orthotic devices.
DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Built for consistent, comfortable performance during active or therapeutic use.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
